Package neqsim.process.util.mercury

Class MercuryProcessReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.mercury.MercuryProcessReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MercuryProcessReport extends Object implements Serializable
Mercury in a calculated process: every stream, every unit operation and the overall mercury balance.

Created by MercuryProcessAnalyzer. The report is a snapshot; run the analyzer again after the process is recalculated.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Method Details

    • getStreams

      public List<MercuryStreamResult> getStreams()
      Get the mercury in every stream of the process.
      Returns:
      unmodifiable list in the order the streams are found in the process

    • getStream

      public MercuryStreamResult getStream(String name)
      Get the mercury in one stream.
      Parameters:
      name - label of the stream in the report, the unit operation it leaves and the stream name joined by a dot (for example "cold separator.gasOutStream"), or the stream name when only one stream has that name
      Returns:
      mercury in the stream
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no stream, or more than one stream, matches the name

    • getStreamsWithFreeMercury

      public List<MercuryStreamResult> getStreamsWithFreeMercury()
      Get the streams that carry free mercury.
      Returns:
      streams that hold more mercury than their fluid phases dissolve

    • getUnits

      public List<MercuryUnitResult> getUnits()
      Get the mercury balance of every unit operation with connected streams.
      Returns:
      unmodifiable list in the order the unit operations are found in the process

    • getUnit

      public MercuryUnitResult getUnit(String name)
      Get the mercury balance of one unit operation.
      Parameters:
      name - name of the unit operation
      Returns:
      mercury balance of the unit operation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the report has no unit operation with the name

    • getFeedMercuryFlowRate

      public double getFeedMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury entering the process with its feed streams.
      Parameters:
      unit - "mole/sec", "mole/hr", "kg/sec", "kg/min", "kg/hr", "kg/day", "kg/yr", "g/sec", "g/hr", "g/day" or "g/yr"
      Returns:
      flow of mercury
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getProductMercuryFlowRate

      public double getProductMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury leaving the process with its product streams.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getFeedMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      flow of mercury, dissolved and free
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getRetainedMercuryFlowRate

      public double getRetainedMercuryFlowRate(String unit)
      Get the mercury that stays in the unit operations of the process.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getFeedMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      sum over the unit operations of mercury entering minus mercury leaving
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getFreeMercuryAccumulationRate

      public double getFreeMercuryAccumulationRate(String unit)
      Get the free mercury held back in the separators of the process.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getFeedMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      sum of the accumulation rates of free mercury in separators with free mercury accumulation enabled
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getMercuryBalanceError

      public double getMercuryBalanceError(String unit)
      Get the mercury that the report does not account for.
      Parameters:
      unit - flow unit, see getFeedMercuryFlowRate(String)
      Returns:
      feed mercury minus product mercury minus mercury retained in the unit operations; not zero when a stream is used by more than one unit operation or a unit operation does not report its streams
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not supported

    • getMaximumSaturationRatio

      public double getMaximumSaturationRatio()
      Get the highest degree of mercury saturation in the process.
      Returns:
      highest saturation ratio of the streams; above one means free mercury in at least one stream

    • hasFreeMercury

      public boolean hasFreeMercury()
      Check whether free mercury forms anywhere in the process.
      Returns:
      true when a stream carries free mercury or a separator holds free mercury back

    • toJson

      public String toJson()
      Get the report as JSON.
      Returns:
      JSON text with the overall balance, the streams and the unit operations; flows in g/day, gas concentrations in ug/Sm3 and liquid concentrations in ug/kg
